title: S198 later notes: gate close on a failed status read, doctor FAIL line repeat, gate no-fix wording
lead: Three small follow-ups from S198's review, gate and UI pass.
findings_note: S198 review, gate and UI pass 2026-10-30 (later findings)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Later findings from S198 (2026-10-30), all optional polish:

- **Test the v11 gate close when the git status read fails.** On a v11 run `internal/engine/round.go:385-389` closes the gate step without a verdict when the read-only fingerprint (git status) fails, and no test drives that path. Add one beside `internal/engine/contract_v11_test.go`.
- **Drop the repeated accepted set from the doctor contract FAIL line.** It prints the set twice: `[FAIL] contract  accepts v10, v11, slicer prints "Contract: relay v9": ork accepts relay v10, v11 and slicer prints v9` (`internal/cli/doctor.go:418` plus `internal/roles/roles.go:84`). This predates S198.
- **Tighten the gate's no-fix criterion wording.** `internal/roles/prompts/gate.md:41-42` adds two full sentences where the other criteria are short "no X;" fragments, and writes `fix` without brackets and `[later]` with brackets on one line. If it changes, update `internal/roles/roles_test.go` (the gate-criteria test) to match.

The verdict-before-triage question is a note on S204.
